independent_support: checks/IndepFixHand.lean (refutation pattern; conditional on Array Bool ≠ List Bool); argument only
name: inst
reason: independent (type-identity): ¬T' is consistent: in any model with Array Bool ≠ List Bool the counter monad of checks/IndepFixHand.lean (map adds 1 iff source type = target type) refutes it (left map at Array Bool → List Bool, right at List Bool → List Bool). T' is consistent: interpret Array β as List β with Array.mk := List.reverse; then both bind chains and both maps are literally the same terms, so T' holds for every monad. Lean proves neither Array Bool = List Bool nor its negation (the types are in bijection). Same refutation succeeds for Vector.toList_scanlM, where Vector Bool 1 ≠ List Bool is provable.
